dedupe_keys.name: realization times of energetic modernization measures for buildings based on interviews with craftworkers

description: Realization times of energetic modernization measures for buildings based on interviews with craftworkers is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Jan Richarz et al. Modernizing existing buildings can reduce carbon emissions. Many countries face the challenge of modernizing a considerable number of their buildings in the next two decades. Implementing related modernization measures requires a high number of craftworkers. However, current studies indicate that these craftworkers’ current lack will increase. Coverage: global; published in 2023. Formats: CSV, Excel, JSON. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
